::: {style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.5;"}
Hi! My name is Alina. I am a data professional, specialising in [
  <span>data analytics</span>
  <span>data visualisation</span>
  <span>data engineering</span>
  <span>computer vision</span>
  <span>databases</span>
  <span>web applications</span>
  <span>all things data, actually</span>
]{.rotating}. At present, I work as a consultant in the United Nations system, building data products to advance evidence-based decision-making. I program in Python and sometimes in R, and also occasionally contribute to open-source projects.

In addition to my two master's degrees in quantitative social sciences, I hold an [MSc in Big Data]{.emphasise} and Professional Diploma in [Artificial Intelligence for Computer Vision]{.emphasise}. I am currently pursuing a [PhD at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam]{.emphasise} in the Netherlands. My research project focuses on applying computer vision to satellite imagery and geospatial data for the Sustainable Development Goals monitoring.

Originally from Ukraine, I now live in Southern Europe ☀️. Outside of work, I enjoy hiking, running, and exploring new places.

Follow me on GitHub or get in touch with me using the links below.
:::
